scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @momentum/api" "npm run dev -w @momentum/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @momentum/engine && npm run build -w @momentum/api && npm run build -w @momentum/web
scripts.format: prettier --write apps/api apps/web/src packages/engine scripts '*.json' '*.yaml' docs README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps/api apps/web/src packages/engine scripts '*.json' '*.yaml' docs README.md
